changes: Open world: Nearby shares the enemies you see with your group, your guild and other Highground users, and the world map shows them with a heatmap of who won the fights there in the last hour.
Track an enemy with Track in the journal or /hg nearby track NAME to hear where they turn up, mark gankers with /hg nearby mark ganker, and see busy zones with /hg activity.
In a party or raid in the open world, kill order, health bars and healer markers work on the enemies around you.
Battlegrounds: a Win forecast panel, readable enemy health bars, a Warsong Gulch flag respawn countdown, and WoW Forever fixes for resurrection timers, healer crosses and druid specs.
Highground uses much less memory: settings pages are built when opened, maps update their pins in place, and only your language and recent match timelines load at login.
notice: This is an alpha: on CurseForge or Wago, allow alpha files for Highground to get it. Restart the game after updating; /reload is not enough because it adds new addon folders.
